reviews.text:
I was with a reputable travel agent prior to using Entire travel my travel consultant had left during the Covid period so when I contacted the company another call centre staff spoke to me and said they would get someone back to me about my request. No response back so I contacted another six or seven companies from the internet. Some only done their own pre packaged deals and others only did one side of the country or the other. I found two companies that could do what I needed. One of these companies failed to get back to me and when I contacted them back they asked for a couple of more days to get back to me.
With the staff member at Entire travel every time we spoke she set a time on when I would hear back from her. They really put them self into your shoes and plan the holiday as if they would be taking it. I didn't even think of the small plane trip to Whistler and found it put in and loved the idea. I can say all the reviews I have seen from previous customers are true and can't wait to experience my trip to Canada. The women serving me was highly experienced in Canada and has made me feel like I made the best decision to use them. I have been travelling overseas almost every year for the past 35 years
Booked a trip for the family to New Calidonia with Entire Travel Group.   Friendly team that helped put a great holiday together.   Will use again.    Such a great time!   Great food great service.

We took a trip to Tahiti with Entire Travel Group to celebrate our 10 year wedding anniversary. Their staff were very knowledgeable and professional and went to every effort to ensure our trip was exactly what we had dreamed of. Highly recommend.

Fantastic service and incredibly knowledgeable. I could not recommend the Entire Travel Group more highly. It was an absolute pleasure working with the team to create our holiday. Always responsive, they have so many wonderful recommendations and nothing is ever too hard. You will not regret booking your travel through these guys, they are the experts!

Entire Travel did a fantastic job organising our holiday! Their suggestions were excellent and they anticipated our every need. They were prompt with their service and communication. We will use them again and we would definitely recommend them to others.
Highly recommend the team at Entire Travel Group. Their fantastic service, knowledge and friendly staff made booking our family holiday stress free. Will definitely book with them again.

Entire Travel Group were fantastic organising our holiday to Tahiti. They took care of everything and provided some great advice targeted to the type of holiday we said we were looking for. They even suggested places to go and see that you would expect from locals.  We would highly recommend them and can't wait to book our next trip.

Thank you to the France team for looking after us when we booked our recent trip to Champagne and Alsace. Everything went so smoothly, the hotels you suggested were absolutely perfect! Looking forward to booking our next trip with you... we just need to decide where to next!

My dealings with Entire Travel Group were professional and pleasant and considering my itinerary was detailed I was impressed with the attention my booking received.

I was also pleased with responses to my calls or e-mails which were always handled quickly and efficiently.
All my dealings with Entire Travel Group have been great - their team members are so friendly and helpful.  Wonderful service, would definitely use them again.
